title: The Amber Cliff
text: A cliff of amber glows like a low sun in the grey light. Things are caught inside it, hanging where they died: insects, birds, a fox in mid-leap. Further in, a man, his mouth open, his hand pressed flat against the inside as if he is still trying to get out.

outcomes.text: It comes away in warm, glowing chunks, worth their weight in Essence. Nobody looks too closely at what is inside them.

options.label: The strongest cuts the man free.

outcomes.text: He breathes, and weeps, and thanks you, and pays in coin no one has minted for a thousand years.
He breathes, and stretches, and stretches, and he is not a man.

options.label: The wisest studies the creatures in the amber.

outcomes.text: Old creatures, long gone from the world, and a few that never should have been in it.
